name: Bun
description: Bun is an all-in-one JavaScript runtime, package manager, test runner, and bundler. Designed as a drop-in replacement for Node.js, it delivers blazing-fast startup times and built-in TypeScript support.

items.title: Bun Official Docs
items.description: The comprehensive official documentation covering runtime APIs, installation, and migration guides.

items.description: Code samples and walkthroughs for servers, routing, databases, and bundling.

items.title: Bun API Reference
items.description: Complete API reference for Bun runtime including file I/O, networking, and SQLite.

items.title: Bun CLI Reference
items.description: Command-line reference for bun install, bun run, bun test, and bun build.
